meta.name: find-skills
meta.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现并安装可扩展功能的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户常问如何实现某个功能，需要推荐安装技能。
copy.tagline_en: Discover and install skills to extend capabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users often ask how to do something and need skill recommendations.

howto.what: 当你问某件事怎么做时，Claude 会先查 skills.sh 榜单再搜索现成技能，核实安装量和来源，把技能名称、用途、安装命令列给你，也可以直接替你装上。
howto.when: 当你问「X 怎么做」「有没有做 X 的技能」，或表示想扩展 Claude 的能力时，它会接管去找技能。

say.text: 有没有帮我优化 React 性能的技能？
say.note: 它先查榜单再搜索，列出候选。

say.text: 帮我找一个做 PR review 的技能。
say.note: 给出安装量、来源和安装命令。

say.text: 把找到的 changelog 技能帮我装上。
say.note: 用 npx skills add 全局安装。

howto.what_en: Claude checks the skills.sh leaderboard, then searches for existing skills, verifies install counts and sources, and lists each skill's name, purpose and install command. It can also install the skill for you.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask how to do X, ask for a skill for X, or say you want to extend Claude's capabilities.

say_en.text: Is there a skill for speeding up my React app?
say_en.note: It checks the leaderboard, then searches.

say_en.text: Find me a skill for PR reviews.
say_en.note: Shows install count, source and install command.

say_en.text: Install that changelog skill for me.
say_en.note: Installs it globally via npx skills add.
